title.en: Selling a collector's piece: from Quick to your first collector
title.af: Verkoop 'n versamelstuk: van Quick tot jou eerste versamelaar
title.zu: Ukuthengisa into yomqoqi: kusukela ku-Quick kuya kumqoqi wakho wokuqala
title.xh: Ukuthengisa into yomqokeleli: ukusuka kwi-Quick ukuya kumqokeleli wakho wokuqala
title.nso: Go rekiša selo sa mokgobokedi: go tloga go Quick go ya go mokgobokedi wa gago wa mathomo

en: Open Quick, swipe to [[Collectors]] and tap [[Sell a piece]]
Swipe the Quick door until it says Collectors. One tap starts your advert.
af: Maak Quick oop, swiep na [[Collectors]] en tik [[Sell a piece]]
Swiep die Quick-deur tot dit Collectors sê. Een tik begin jou advertensie.
zu: Vula i-Quick, swayipha uye ku-[[Collectors]] bese uthepha [[Sell a piece]]
Swayipha umnyango we-Quick uze ubone u-Collectors. Ukuthepha kanye kuqala isikhangiso sakho.
xh: Vula i-Quick, tyibilikisa uye kwi-[[Collectors]] uze ucofe [[Sell a piece]]
Tyibilikisa ucango lwe-Quick de lubonise u-Collectors. Ukucofa kanye kuqalisa intengiso yakho.
nso: Bula Quick, šutiša go ya go [[Collectors]] o kgotle [[Sell a piece]]
Šutiša lebati la Quick go fihlela le re Collectors. Go kgotla gatee go thoma papatšo ya gago.

en: Pick [[Coins]]
Coins, stamps, cards, militaria, watches or art.
af: Kies [[Coins]]
Munte, seëls, kaarte, militêre items, horlosies of kuns.
zu: Khetha [[Coins]]
Izinhlamvu zemali, izitembu, amakhadi, izinto zamasosha, amawashi noma ubuciko.
xh: Khetha [[Coins]]
Iingqekembe, izitampu, amakhadi, izinto zomkhosi, iiwotshi okanye ubugcisa.
nso: Kgetha [[Coins]]
Ditšhelete tša tshipi, ditempe, dikarata, dilo tša bohlabani, diwatšhe goba bokgabo.

en: Pick its condition
Mint, near mint, good, played or ungraded.
af: Kies sy toestand
Mint, near mint, good, played of ungraded.
zu: Khetha isimo sayo
Mint, near mint, good, played noma ungraded.
xh: Khetha imeko yayo
Mint, near mint, good, played okanye ungraded.
nso: Kgetha boemo bja yona
Mint, near mint, good, played goba ungraded.

en: Say if it is authenticated
Graded, a certificate, or not yet.
af: Sê of dit gewaarmerk is
Gegradeer, 'n sertifikaat, of nog nie.
zu: Yisho ukuthi iqinisekisiwe yini
Ihleliwe ngamabanga, inesitifiketi, noma akukabi njalo.
xh: Yitsho ukuba iqinisekisiwe na
Ihlelwe ngamabakala, inesatifikethi, okanye akukabi njalo.
nso: Bolela ge e netefaditšwe
E beilwe maemo, e na le setifikeiti, goba ga se ya ba bjalo.

en: Type your price
Tap [[Another option]] and type it. You can change it later, for example after the market report.
af: Tik jou prys
Tik [[Another option]] en tik dit. Jy kan dit later verander, byvoorbeeld ná die markverslag.
zu: Bhala intengo yakho
Thepha [[Another option]] bese uyibhala. Ungayishintsha kamuva, isibonelo ngemva kombiko wemakethe.
xh: Bhala ixabiso lakho
Cofa [[Another option]] uze ulibhale. Unokulitshintsha kamva, umzekelo emva kwengxelo yemarike.
nso: Ngwala theko ya gago
Kgotla [[Another option]] o e ngwale. O ka e fetoša ka morago, mohlala ka morago ga pego ya mmaraka.

en: Tap your area
Buyers search by area. Your exact address stays private.
af: Tik jou area
Kopers soek volgens area. Jou presiese adres bly privaat.
zu: Thepha indawo yakho
Abathengi basesha ngendawo. Ikheli lakho eliqondile lihlala liyimfihlo.
xh: Cofa indawo yakho
Abathengi bakhangela ngendawo. Idilesi yakho echanekileyo ihlala iyimfihlo.
nso: Kgotla lefelo la gago
Bareki ba nyaka ka lefelo. Aterese ya gago ya nnete e dula e le sephiri.

en: Say exactly what it is, then [[Save my listing]]
Type it the way a collector would search, for example "1974 Krugerrand, 1 oz gold proof". Saving is free.
af: Sê presies wat dit is, dan [[Save my listing]]
Tik dit soos 'n versamelaar sou soek, byvoorbeeld "1974 Krugerrand, 1 oz gold proof". Stoor is gratis.
zu: Yisho ngqo ukuthi yini, bese [[Save my listing]]
Yibhale ngendlela umqoqi angasesha ngayo, isibonelo "1974 Krugerrand, 1 oz gold proof". Ukulondoloza kumahhala.
xh: Yitsho kanye ukuba yintoni, emva koko [[Save my listing]]
Yibhale ngendlela umqokeleli anokukhangela ngayo, umzekelo "1974 Krugerrand, 1 oz gold proof". Ukugcina kusimahla.
nso: Bolela gabotse gore ke eng, ke moka [[Save my listing]]
E ngwale ka mokgwa wo mokgobokedi a ka nyakago ka wona, mohlala "1974 Krugerrand, 1 oz gold proof". Go boloka ke mahala.

en: Saved: open it in TrustSquare
Tap [[Sign the terms and publish]]. Your advert opens in the Seller Hub.
af: Gestoor: maak dit in TrustSquare oop
Tik [[Sign the terms and publish]]. Jou advertensie maak in die Seller Hub oop.
zu: Kulondoloziwe: kuvule ku-TrustSquare
Thepha [[Sign the terms and publish]]. Isikhangiso sakho sivuleka ku-Seller Hub.
xh: Igciniwe: yivule kwi-TrustSquare
Cofa [[Sign the terms and publish]]. Intengiso yakho ivuleka kwi-Seller Hub.
nso: E bolokilwe: e bule go TrustSquare
Kgotla [[Sign the terms and publish]]. Papatšo ya gago e bulega go Seller Hub.

en: In [[Edit]], tap [[Market report · 5T]]
Before you settle your price: the Collectables report researches real prices for your piece.
af: In [[Edit]], tik [[Market report · 5T]]
Voordat jy jou prys vasstel: die Collectables-verslag soek regte pryse vir jou stuk na.
zu: Ku-[[Edit]], thepha [[Market report · 5T]]
Ngaphambi kokunquma intengo yakho: umbiko we-Collectables ucwaninga amanani angempela ento yakho.
xh: Kwi-[[Edit]], cofa [[Market report · 5T]]
Phambi kokuba ugqibe ixabiso lakho: ingxelo ye-Collectables iphanda amaxabiso okwenyani ento yakho.
nso: Go [[Edit]], kgotla [[Market report · 5T]]
Pele o tiiša theko ya gago: pego ya Collectables e nyakišiša ditheko tša nnete tša selo sa gago.

en: Get the report: 5T
It opens filled in with your item and price. Add a photo and tap [[Get the report · 5T]]. You pay only when the report arrives.
af: Kry die verslag: 5T
Dit maak oop met jou item en prys reeds ingevul. Voeg 'n foto by en tik [[Get the report · 5T]]. Jy betaal net wanneer die verslag aankom.
zu: Thola umbiko: 5T
Uvuleka usugcwaliswe ngento yakho nentengo. Engeza isithombe bese uthepha [[Get the report · 5T]]. Ukhokha kuphela uma umbiko ufika.
xh: Fumana ingxelo: 5T
Ivuleka sele izaliswe ngento yakho nexabiso. Faka ifoto uze ucofe [[Get the report · 5T]]. Uhlawula kuphela xa ingxelo ifikile.
nso: Hwetša pego: 5T
E bulega e šetše e tladitšwe ka selo sa gago le theko. Tsenya seswantšho o kgotle [[Get the report · 5T]]. O lefa feela ge pego e fihla.

en: Attach the report to your advert
Tap [[Attach report to my listing]]. Buyers see the market range next to your price.
af: Heg die verslag aan jou advertensie
Tik [[Attach report to my listing]]. Kopers sien die markreeks langs jou prys.
zu: Namathisela umbiko esikhangisweni sakho
Thepha [[Attach report to my listing]]. Abathengi babona ibanga lemakethe eduze kwentengo yakho.
xh: Qhoboshela ingxelo kwintengiso yakho
Cofa [[Attach report to my listing]]. Abathengi babona uluhlu lwemarike ecaleni kwexabiso lakho.
nso: Kgomaretša pego papatšong ya gago
Kgotla [[Attach report to my listing]]. Bareki ba bona magomo a mmaraka kgauswi le theko ya gago.

en: Fill in the details and set your price
Collection type, condition, catalogue reference (for example KM# 73) and year, then your asking price. Add your own photo.
af: Vul die besonderhede in en stel jou prys
Versamelingsoort, toestand, katalogusverwysing (byvoorbeeld KM# 73) en jaar, dan jou vraprys. Voeg jou eie foto by.
zu: Gcwalisa imininingwane bese ubeka intengo yakho
Uhlobo lweqoqo, isimo, inkomba yekhathalogi (isibonelo KM# 73) nonyaka, bese intengo yakho. Engeza isithombe sakho.
xh: Zalisa iinkcukacha uze ubeke ixabiso lakho
Uhlobo lwengqokelela, imeko, isalathisi sekhathalogu (umzekelo KM# 73) nonyaka, emva koko ixabiso lakho. Faka ifoto yakho.
nso: Tlatša dintlha o bee theko ya gago
Mohuta wa kgoboketšo, boemo, tšhupetšo ya khathalogo (mohlala KM# 73) le ngwaga, ke moka theko ya gago. Tsenya seswantšho sa gago.

en: Accept the seller terms once
At your first [[Save Changes]] the terms open. Read to the end, tick both boxes and tap [[I accept]]. Your photo and details are kept.
af: Aanvaar die verkopersvoorwaardes een keer
By jou eerste [[Save Changes]] maak die voorwaardes oop. Lees tot aan die einde, merk albei blokkies en tik [[I accept]]. Jou foto en besonderhede bly.
zu: Yamukela imigomo yabathengisi kanye
Ku-[[Save Changes]] yakho yokuqala kuvuleka imigomo. Funda kuze kube sekugcineni, khetha amabhokisi womabili bese uthepha [[I accept]]. Isithombe nemininingwane yakho kuyagcinwa.
xh: Yamkela imigaqo yabathengisi kube kanye
Kwi-[[Save Changes]] yakho yokuqala kuvuleka imigaqo. Funda ude uyigqibe, phawula zombini iibhokisi uze ucofe [[I accept]]. Ifoto neenkcukacha zakho ziyagcinwa.
nso: Amogela melawana ya barekiši gatee
Go [[Save Changes]] ya gago ya mathomo melawana e a bulega. Bala go fihla mafelelong, swaya mapokisi ka bobedi o kgotle [[I accept]]. Seswantšho le dintlha tša gago di a bolokwa.

en: Tap [[Publish]]
Your advert is live. Collectors can ask for an introduction straight away.
af: Tik [[Publish]]
Jou advertensie is regstreeks. Versamelaars kan dadelik vir 'n voorstelling vra.
zu: Thepha [[Publish]]
Isikhangiso sakho sesibukhoma. Abaqoqi bangacela ukwethulwa ngokushesha.
xh: Cofa [[Publish]]
Intengiso yakho iphilayo. Abaqokeleli banokucela ukwaziswa ngoko nangoko.
nso: Kgotla [[Publish]]
Papatšo ya gago e phela. Bakgobokedi ba ka kgopela go tsebišwa gona bjale.

en: A collector opens Quick: [[Find a piece]]
She picks Coins, what she can spend and how rare.
af: 'n Versamelaar maak Quick oop: [[Find a piece]]
Sy kies Coins, wat sy kan spandeer en hoe skaars.
zu: Umqoqi uvula i-Quick: [[Find a piece]]
Ukhetha u-Coins, angakusebenzisa nokuthi kuyivelakancane kangakanani.
xh: Umqokeleli uvula i-Quick: [[Find a piece]]
Ukhetha u-Coins, anokukusebenzisa nokuba inqabile kangakanani.
nso: Mokgobokedi o bula Quick: [[Find a piece]]
O kgetha Coins, seo a ka se šomišago le go hwetšagala ga yona.

en: She finds your coin
Real adverts and marked AI examples, in her city. She taps yours.
af: Sy kry jou munt
Regte advertensies en gemerkte KI-voorbeelde, in haar stad. Sy tik op joune.
zu: Uthola uhlamvu lwakho
Izikhangiso zangempela nezibonelo ze-AI eziphawuliwe, edolobheni lakhe. Uthepha olwakho.
xh: Ufumana ingqekembe yakho
Iintengiso zokwenyani nemizekelo ye-AI ephawuliweyo, kwisixeko sakhe. Ucofa eyakho.
nso: O hwetša tšhelete ya gago ya tshipi
Dipapatšo tša nnete le mehlala ya AI ye e swailwego, toropong ya gagwe. O kgotla ya gago.

en: She reads your advert
Price, condition, catalogue reference and year. Your name stays hidden.
af: Sy lees jou advertensie
Prys, toestand, katalogusverwysing en jaar. Jou naam bly versteek.
zu: Ufunda isikhangiso sakho
Intengo, isimo, inkomba yekhathalogi nonyaka. Igama lakho lihlala lifihliwe.
xh: Ufunda intengiso yakho
Ixabiso, imeko, isalathisi sekhathalogu nonyaka. Igama lakho lihlala lifihliwe.
nso: O bala papatšo ya gago
Theko, boemo, tšhupetšo ya khathalogo le ngwaga. Leina la gago le dula le utilwe.

en: She checks the price: [[Is this a fair price?]]
A catalogue or market price for your piece, 1T, charged only if a real figure comes back.
af: Sy toets die prys: [[Is this a fair price?]]
'n Katalogus- of markprys vir jou stuk, 1T, net gehef as 'n regte syfer terugkom.
zu: Uhlola intengo: [[Is this a fair price?]]
Inani lekhathalogi noma lemakethe lento yakho, 1T, kukhokhwa kuphela uma kubuya inani langempela.
xh: Uhlola ixabiso: [[Is this a fair price?]]
Ixabiso lekhathalogu okanye lemarike lento yakho, 1T, kuhlawulwa kuphela xa kubuya inani lokwenyani.
nso: O lekola theko: [[Is this a fair price?]]
Theko ya khathalogo goba ya mmaraka ya selo sa gago, 1T, e lefišwa feela ge palo ya nnete e boa.
steps.note: 1 Oct 2026 (Goal run, after the OpenAI top-up): the 1T check returned a verified range (R72,779-R86,000 asking, 3 named sources) and charged 1T -- proven on the service; the buyer-page screen waits for #455 to be published again

en: She asks for an introduction
She taps [[Join queue]], adds a message and sends. 1T is held from her and only spent if you accept.
af: Sy vra vir 'n voorstelling
Sy tik [[Join queue]], voeg 'n boodskap by en stuur. 1T word van haar teruggehou en net gebruik as jy aanvaar.
zu: Ucela ukwethulwa
Uthepha [[Join queue]], engeze umlayezo bese ethumela. U-1T uyabanjwa kuye futhi usetshenziswa kuphela uma wamukela.
xh: Ucela ukwaziswa
Ucofa [[Join queue]], ongeze umyalezo aze athumele. I-1T iyabanjwa kuye kwaye isetyenziswa kuphela ukuba uyamkela.
nso: O kgopela go tsebišwa
O kgotla [[Join queue]], a oketša molaetša gomme a romela. 1T e swarwa go yena gomme e šomišwa feela ge o amogela.

en: You see her request
Your Seller Hub shows [[1 request waiting]] with her first name and message.
af: Jy sien haar versoek
Jou Seller Hub wys [[1 request waiting]] met haar voornaam en boodskap.
zu: Ubona isicelo sakhe
I-Seller Hub yakho ibonisa [[1 request waiting]] negama lakhe lokuqala nomlayezo.
xh: Ubona isicelo sakhe
I-Seller Hub yakho ibonisa [[1 request waiting]] negama lakhe lokuqala nomyalezo.
nso: O bona kgopelo ya gagwe
Seller Hub ya gago e bontšha [[1 request waiting]] le leina la gagwe la pele le molaetša.

en: Tap [[Accept]]
You pay nothing: her 1T is spent now. You both get an email; reply to it to arrange a viewing. Your email address stays private.
af: Tik [[Accept]]
Jy betaal niks: haar 1T word nou gebruik. Julle kry albei 'n e-pos; antwoord dit om 'n besigtiging te reël. Jou e-posadres bly privaat.
zu: Thepha [[Accept]]
Awukhokhi lutho: u-1T wakhe usetshenziswa manje. Nobabili nithola i-imeyili; yiphendule ukuze nihlele ukubuka. Ikheli lakho le-imeyili lihlala liyimfihlo.
xh: Cofa [[Accept]]
Awuhlawuli nto: i-1T yakhe isetyenziswa ngoku. Nobabini nifumana i-imeyile; yiphendule ukuze nicwangcise ukujonga. Idilesi yakho ye-imeyile ihlala iyimfihlo.
nso: Kgotla [[Accept]]
Ga o lefe selo: 1T ya gagwe e šomišwa bjale. Ka bobedi le hwetša imeile; e arabe gore le beakanye go lebelela. Aterese ya gago ya imeile e dula e le sephiri.

en: She sees it accepted
In My Space, under Intros, her request shows [[Accepted]].
af: Sy sien dit is aanvaar
In My Space, onder Intros, wys haar versoek [[Accepted]].
zu: Ubona ukuthi samukelwe
Ku-My Space, ngaphansi kwe-Intros, isicelo sakhe sibonisa [[Accepted]].
xh: Ubona ukuba samkelwe
Kwi-My Space, phantsi kwe-Intros, isicelo sakhe sibonisa [[Accepted]].
nso: O bona gore e amogetšwe
Go My Space, ka fase ga Intros, kgopelo ya gagwe e bontšha [[Accepted]].

en: Pass Quick on
Tap [[Pass Quick on to someone]] and share it with a friend who collects.
af: Gee Quick aan
Tik [[Pass Quick on to someone]] en deel dit met 'n vriend wat versamel.
zu: Dlulisela i-Quick
Thepha [[Pass Quick on to someone]] bese uyabelana ngayo nomngane oqoqayo.
xh: Dlulisela i-Quick
Cofa [[Pass Quick on to someone]] uze wabelane ngayo nomhlobo oqokelelayo.
nso: Fetišetša Quick pele
Kgotla [[Pass Quick on to someone]] o e abelane le mogwera yo a kgoboketšago.
